scope: Max-level PvE guide baseline; alternatives are conditional, not simultaneous selections.

stat_guidance.raid: Item level > Haste = Mastery > Critical Strike >= Versatility.
stat_guidance.mplus: Dedicated M+ section: item level > Haste > Mastery > Versatility > Critical Strike.
stat_guidance.conflict: Guide also lists Haste = Mastery for M+ earlier; do not treat either as precise weights.
stat_guidance.high_keys: With sufficient healing, emphasize Haste then Versatility for damage and survival; more Mastery supports healing.

conditions: Use Lightfused Mana Potion when mana recovery is needed; cooldown interaction is unverified.
Quick Amethyst and Harandar Celebration are listed alternatives.
unresolved: Exact quality ranks and full use restrictions are unverified.
Consumable durations and cooldown-sharing require tooltip verification.
validation_scope: Current guide recommendations and linked identities; no personal optimization or independent full tooltip verification.
